blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Farm Fresh continued to make history on Thursday, punching its ticket to its first-ever PVL Finals after stunning top seed Nxled, 26-24, 25-16, 23-25, 17-25, 15-11, in a win-or-go-home semifinal game in the 2026 Siklab Series at Philsports Arena. For the first time since joining the league in 2023, Trisha Tubu and the Foxies will compete for a championship in a breakthrough for the franchise. Making their second straight All-Filipino semifinals appearance, the Foxies hardly showed signs of intimidation against the Chameleons, the top blocking team that swept the eight-game elimination round for the twice-to-beat advantage.
